description: This Java class defines an Android IntentService called UpdateQuestionService, which updates quiz question status data on a paired device (like a phone) via Google Play Services Wearable DataApi when a user answers a question on a Wear OS device. It manages GoogleApiClient connection, handles data synchronization, and cancels related notifications.

classes.name: UpdateQuestionService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that synchronizes quiz answer data from a wearable device to a paired device such as a phone, using GoogleApiClient and DataApi.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and connection callback implementations.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles the intent to update the data item representing the quiz question status on the paired device, and cancels the related notification.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback for successful GoogleApiClient connection (empty implementation).

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback for failed connection attempt (empty implementation).
